name: blood-of-dawnwalker-update-1-2-new-game-plus-20261114
lines:
حسب يوروغيمر (Eurogamer)،
الوضع قادم إلى The Blood of Dawnwalker

من أنهى خاتمة اللعبة
يعود بمستواه ومهاراته وأغراضه

الحد الأقصى للمستوى 100
مع قوة أعداء موحدة
headline:
لعبة Dawnwalker
تحصل على New Game Plus
label: تقرير

angle.hook: The Blood of Dawnwalker is getting New Game Plus: finishers keep level, skills and items and the level cap rises to 100
angle.why_now: Eurogamer reported on 13 Nov, quoting developer Rebel Wolves, that Update 1.2 is planned for next week; no Arabic outlet has carried it yet
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf players who finished the September RPG can replay it with their build; the game costs 229 AED on Steam in the UAE and 239 SR in Saudi Arabia, with no Arabic among its languages
angle.payoff: the update is planned for any day next week and the full patch notes are still to come, so only the New Game Plus details Rebel Wolves gave are confirmed by the report

tried: Steam Launch Trailer: narrated over the whole 92 s (faster-whisper small, vad on and off, 14 Nov), horror scenes with a demon
Steam Update 1.1 Trailer: PEGI 18 card at 0 to 3 s, a burnt-in feature caption on every gameplay shot, blood in the combat, one dialogue line at 35 to 39 s, an AVAILABLE NOW key-art card
Steam Features Trailer (6 min): narrated throughout with burnt-in subtitles, very dark, vampire feeding scenes
Cinematic and Pre-Order trailers (opened and transcribed by the director): voiced story trailers with dialogue throughout, no music-only stretch
Steam Story trailer: download failed here, not opened; Summer Game Fest trailer: not opened

bed_reason: Stills Reel on official Steam screenshots, which have no sound of their own, so our bed plays under them and the jingle on the end card. Trailers opened: Launch (narrated under all 92 s), Update 1.1 (PEGI 18 card, burnt-in captions on every shot, blood, dialogue at 35 to 39 s, key-art card), Features (narrated through 6 minutes with burnt-in subtitles, dark), and the Cinematic and Pre-Order trailers (voiced story trailers with dialogue throughout, no music-only stretch, checked by the director). The Story trailer download failed and the Summer Game Fest trailer was not opened.
